title: Myths from around the world
examples: What is the difference between a myth and a legend?
Why do different cultures have different myths?

explain.say: Today we will explore myths from many different places. A myth is a story that explains how things came to be.
Anansi is a very famous trickster figure from West Africa. He often causes trouble but sometimes helps people too.
The Ramayana is an epic story from India. It tells the tale of Prince Rama's journey and victory.
Maui is a powerful hero from Polynesian legends. He is known for pulling islands from the sea.
Every culture tells myths because stories help people understand their world. They explain big questions about life.
When you see a rainbow after the rain, you might think of a myth. People often link natural events to stories.

faq.q: Are myths the same as legends?
faq.a: Not exactly. Myths often explain natural things using gods. Legends are usually stories about real historical people or places.
asks: What is the difference between myth and legend?

faq.q: Do all cultures have heroes like Maui?
faq.a: No. Every culture has its own unique heroes and figures. These figures teach important lessons to their people.
asks: Do all cultures have strong heroes?
Where can I find stories about local heroes?

faq.q: Who is Anansi and what does he represent?
faq.a: Anansi is a trickster figure. He often uses cleverness to get what he wants, which teaches lessons about wit.
asks: What is Anansi's role in stories?
Is Anansi always bad in stories?

faq.q: Why do people tell stories about gods?
faq.a: People use stories about gods to explain things they do not fully understand. It helps them make sense of the world around them.
asks: What do myths teach us about life?

faq.q: Is the Ramayana a true history?
faq.a: No, it is an epic story. It uses characters and events to teach moral lessons about duty and good versus evil.
asks: Are the characters in the Ramayana real?
Is the Ramayana a factual history book?

facts: Myths are traditional stories explaining natural phenomena.
Anansi is a trickster figure from West African folklore.
The Ramayana is an epic tale from India.
Maui is a hero credited with creating islands in Polynesian myths.

quiz.say: A story explaining how the seasons changed is most likely a:
quiz.why: Myths are designed to explain big natural events using story.

wrong.0: Legends usually focus on human heroes or historical times.
wrong.1: Folktales are often simple stories for entertainment only.
wrong.3: Facts are things that can be proven with science.

quiz.say: If a story is about a character pulling land from the sea, it is likely about:
quiz.why: Maui is famous in Polynesian myths for this type of feat.

wrong.1: Anansi is more known for his clever tricks.
wrong.2: Rama's stories focus more on duty and exile.
wrong.3: A natural cycle describes repeating patterns, not a single feat.

quiz.say: Which word best describes the main purpose of myths?
quiz.why: The main job of myths is to give explanations for life and nature.

wrong.1: While myths entertain, their deeper purpose is explanation.
wrong.2: Myths are not meant to be strict historical records.
wrong.3: Warning is sometimes part of it, but it is not the main goal.
